open_points: The source specifies CRC_IDR.IDR as bits 31:0 with reset value 0x0000 0000 but does not require any requirement for the reset value within this write/read slice, so no reset/startup requirement is generated here.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Write_IDR with a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall write the supplied 32-bit value to CRC_IDR.IDR.
requirements.verification: The test calls LL_CRC_Write_IDR with a 32-bit value on a valid accessible CRC instance and passes when CRC_IDR.IDR reads back the supplied value.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Read_IDR on a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall read the current 32-bit value of CRC_IDR.IDR and return it.
requirements.verification: The test invokes LL_CRC_Read_IDR on a valid accessible CRC instance and passes when the returned value equals the current value of CRC_IDR.IDR.
